item.description:
Location: Indonesia, Pakistan
Description:

Vacancies are available for Indonesian crew on various vessel types including Bulk Carriers (Capesize and Panamax), Small Container Vessels, Deck Barges, VLGCs, Oil Chemical Tankers, Oil Product Vessels, and Tugboats. Description:

A Ship Repair Supervisor is sought to oversee daily vessel repair activities and coordinate multidisciplinary teams. Knowledge of hull, welding, fitting, mechanical, piping, and electrical works is essential, along with strong leadership and HSE awareness. Proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English is also required.

Location: Oman
Description:

A maritime professional with 5+ years of experience is sought for a Vessel Handling Executive or Port Operations Executive role. This full-time, on-site position involves coordinating vessel calls, port clearances, crew logistics, and cargo operations. Responsibilities include preparing documentation, liaising with port authorities, managing vessel husbandry, monitoring cargo, and handling disbursement accounts. A Master’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience is required, along with strong English communication and problem-solving skills. Flexibility for irregular hours is necessary.



Apply to this job
